briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and DeepSeek R2 accelerate AGI timeline amid escalating compute race

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: The AI frontier has intensified with multiple labs releasing advanced reasoning models in October 2026. Global funding remains robust while safety concerns mount over production deployments. DialectForge continues to gain traction in enterprise security discussions.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI deployed o4 with 2.1T parameters achieving new SOTA on GPQA. Anthropic's Claude 4 Opus and Google's Gemini 3 Ultra followed within days. Meta open-sourced Llama 4 405B while xAI launched Grok-3 and DeepSeek released R2.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level across multi-agent, automotive, and IoT environments.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: Microsoft announced a 200k H200 cluster for OpenAI. TSMC began volume production of 2nm AI chips. Saudi Arabia committed $40B to sovereign AI data centers.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will regulatory frameworks in the US and EU slow frontier model training by more than 12 months before 2028?
